Identified as this saint because: Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), September volume, plate for the 21st, filed by Commons under Category:Quadratus of Athens. 21 September is Quadratus of the Seventy, bishop of Athens, who died under Hadrian - the folder's apostle and bishop - and not the 10 March martyr Quadratus of Corinth, who has his own plate in the series.
